tasks.title: FizzBuzz Tutorial
tasks.description:
Welcome to the function tutorial! This task will help you practice writing Python functions with our AI assistant.

Task: Implement FizzBuzz. Given an integer n, return the FizzBuzz result for that number:

  • If divisible by both 3 and 5, return "FizzBuzz"
  • If divisible by 3, return "Fizz"
  • If divisible by 5, return "Buzz"
  • Otherwise return the number as a string

Example:

For input 15, return FizzBuzz. For input 3, return Fizz. For input 7, return 7.

The solution function receives the input as a string (e.g. "15") and should return the output as a string.

Once you're done, click on the Submit / Finish Tutorial button to complete the tutorial and move on to the main function tasks.
